name: javascript-blueprint-build
description: Build tooling for The JavaScript Blueprint. Not published.
comment:
These were installed with --no-save and no package.json, so the next --no-save install pruned whatever was not asked for - which is how marked disappeared mid-session and the build stopped dead. Listing them fixes that. marked is pinned EXACTLY, not with a caret: render.mjs escapes the text of an inline code span itself, and in marked 12 that text arrives already escaped, so `

` came out as literal <p> through the whole book. A caret range let npm choose 12 and silently broke every inline code span.
